maddeler.e:
يتحاور (form VI)
# يَتَحَاوَرُ (yataḥāwaru) /ja.ta.ħaː.wa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَحَاوَرَ (taḥāwara)
# يَتَحَاوَرَ (yataḥāwara) /ja.ta.ħaː.wa.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَحَاوَرَ (taḥāwara)
# يَتَحَاوَرْ (yataḥāwar) /ja.ta.ħaː.war/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَحَاوَرَ (taḥāwara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
